summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) with hands-on experience profiling and optimizing inference at the kernel level, including custom CUDA C++ kernels for convolutional inference and TensorRT deployment pipelines. Built and profiled an 8-bit quantized language model, cutting GPU memory footprint by 55% while validating latency, throughput, and accuracy trade-offs with pynvml. Comfortable writing production Python and C++, working through ambiguous performance problems, and turning measurable optimization gains into deployed systems.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via improved preprocessing and model tuning.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU; reported accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.
Led a cross-cultural team of 7 as the sole ML-experienced student; took over as team lead mid-project to restructure task distribution and deliver the full pipeline within the 6-week window.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Delivered a 35% inference speedup (49.2ms vs. 73.3ms uncoalesced, 77.5ms CPU TorchScript baseline) by replacing VGG16's TorchScript conv layers with custom CUDA C++ kernels.
Used memory coalescing, constant memory for weights/biases, and preallocated global buffers to eliminate per-layer allocation overhead, achieving 1.5–2x speedup in convolution operations.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and inference latency across prompt types using pynvml and psutil.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC; <1% accuracy degradation with +0.09 perplexity increase — near-lossless compression.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2x speedup: 56.7→10.9ms, 17.6→92 FPS vs eager PyTorch) for real-time visual servoing within a three-layer distributed inference pipeline (Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, Jetson+Arduino controller).
Resolved 11 integration failures across the pipeline (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture), achieving 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer from scratch in PyTorch: multi-head self-attention, MLP blocks, residual connections, layer norm, and weight tying.
Built a TikToken-based tokenizer wrapper and custom training loop with early stopping and perplexity evaluation; validated text generation on a fantasy-themed text corpus.
